approval.decision: Accept protocol-conformance promotion criterion for KND002, SUP001, and SUP002 only.

criteria.protocol_matrix: positive and negative cases, malformed input, scope priority, disabled and incomplete execution, meta-suppression, deterministic complete results, exact original-source locations, and executable rule examples
criteria.natural_regression: No unwanted diagnostics on the unmodified natural holdout. Complete rule-evaluation receipt must confirm this before promotion.

review.scope_priority: Reviewed the production match ordering: block before file, smaller block before wider block, then earlier source position. Tests assert exactly one active winner and the other declaration stale.
review.meta_suppression: Reviewed separate first-order stale matching and final unused SUP002 pass. Tests assert equal file SUP002 declarations cannot give each other circular credit.
review.incomplete_execution: Existing fixtures assert incomplete rules can suppress known diagnostics without being reported stale; disabled rules receive no stale diagnostic.

validation.command: cargo test -p seiso_rules --test engine --test suppression --test acceptance_contract --locked

natural_regression_verification: The M1 aggregate evaluation verifies zero unwanted natural holdout diagnostics against its frozen diagnostic report before promotion.
